entities.name: Jean Malouel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Malouel, or Jan Maelwael in his native Dutch, was a Dutch artist who was the court painter of Philip the Bold, Duke of Burgundy and his successor John the Fearless, working in the International Gothic style.
